name: Griswold's Temper
lore: Griswold the smith tempered every blade and breastplate the town owned.

name: Lachdanan's Oath
lore: Lachdanan, captain of Leoric's knights, fought the king's curse with all the honour he had left.

name: Mindful Awareness
lore: The body moves; the mind shields.

name: Way of the Staff
lore: The monks of Ivgorod carry no blade, only the staff.

name: Light Feet
lore: A Sister of the Sightless Eye is never where the blow lands.

name: Sisterhood Volley
lore: The Sisters loose together, and nothing stands in the field before them.

name: Pure Energy
lore: Raw mana, wrapped about the body like a second skin.

name: Vizjerei Lore
lore: The Vizjerei clan taught that every spell is a bargain struck with power.

name: Light of Zakarum
lore: The Zakarum preached that the Light burns away all evil.

name: Akarat's Faith
lore: Faith in the prophet Akarat kept the paladins standing.

name: Lightforge
lore: A forgotten weapon of light and fire from the old Tristram lists.

name: Militia Drill
lore: Every able man of Tristram drilled on the green before Leoric's march.

name: Farnham's Courage
lore: Farnham saw what lies below and lived. Barely.

name: Captain of the Levy
lore: A captain fights with whatever the armoury had left.

name: Monastery Discipline
lore: The monastery of the Sightless Eye trains hand and eye until they are one.

name: Swift Strikes
lore: Strike and be gone.

name: Wizardspike
lore: A mage's dagger, as quick to a spell as to a throat.

name: Horadric Scrolls
lore: The Horadrim wrote down everything they learned of the Prime Evils.

name: Cain's Learning
lore: The last of the Horadrim reads by candlelight.

name: Naj's Puzzler
lore: A staff for a mage in a hurry.

name: Gloomy Shrine
lore: Those who defend seldom attack Armour also applies to fire, cold and lightning hits. You cannot evade. Less attack damage.

name: Weird Shrine
lore: The sword of justice is swift and sharp Every fifth attack strikes twice, but all your attacks deal 20% reduced damage.

name: Eldritch Shrine
lore: Crimson and Azure become as the sun Spells spend energy shield before mana, and deal up to 25% more damage for it. Energy shield recharges half as fast.

name: Magical Shrine
lore: While the spirit is vigilant the body thrives A quarter of hit damage is taken from mana first. Less mana recovery.

name: Glimmering Shrine
lore: Mysteries are revealed in the light of reason More damage against rare and unique monsters, less against the rest.

name: Abandoned Shrine
lore: The hands of men may be guided by fate Evasion also dodges spells. Lower resistances.

name: Quiet Shrine
lore: The essence of life flows from within Life recovery also recovers 60% as much energy shield, even at full life. Energy shield never recharges.

name: Shimmering Shrine
lore: Spiritual energy is restored. 2% increased damage per 10 unreserved Spirit. Less maximum life.

name: Ornate Shrine
lore: Salvation comes at the cost of wisdom All physical attack damage becomes fire. Less maximum mana.

name: Mysterious Shrine
lore: Some are weakened as one grows strong Your minions deal more damage and have more life. Your own attacks and spells deal less damage.

name: Secluded Shrine
lore: The way is made clear when viewed from above More damage while no enemy is near you. You take more damage for a moment after moving.

name: Enchanted Shrine
lore: Magic is not always what it seems to be Your spells cycle fire, cold and lightning. Spells of the current element deal more damage, the others less.

name: Cloister Wall
lore: The cloister walls never fell while a priest still prayed behind them.

name: Holy Defender
lore: A large shield blessed against fire and quick to rise against a blow.

name: Hand of Zakarum
lore: The battle priest strikes and prays in one breath.

name: Naj's Light Plate
lore: Plate light enough for a mage to wear into battle.

name: Tithe of the Cloister
lore: The church takes its tithe, and the faithful are stronger for paying it.

name: Sanctuary of Light
lore: Stand in the Light and be mended.

name: Sermon of Light
lore: Every dawn the priests of Tristram preached to the faithful.

name: Litany of Mending
lore: Chanted over the wounded until the bleeding stops.

name: Lazarus's Lie
lore: Power, offered by a traitor. It always costs.

name: Que-Hegan's Fall
lore: Mephisto took the Que-Hegan's body and ruled the Zakarum from within.

name: Ogden's Provisions
lore: Ogden poured strong for anyone with the nerve to go below, and never had enough to go round.

name: Gillian's Hearth
lore: Gillian kept the Rising Sun warm for whoever came back up.

name: Adria's Brews
lore: The witch by the river sells what Pepin will not.

name: Levy Shieldmen
lore: Leoric's levies marched north with a sword in hand and a shield on the arm.

name: Arbalest of the Levy
lore: Crossbows for the men who had never drawn a bow.

name: Marching Order
lore: Keep pace, keep formation.

name: The March on Westmarch
lore: Leoric sent his army north against Westmarch. Few came home.

name: Leoric's Legion
lore: Leoric's knights rose again. Now yours do.

name: Royal Crypt
lore: The crypt kept its dead in good armour.

name: Inner Sight
lore: The Sisters learned from Eastern teachers to see without eyes.

name: Tracker
lore: The Sisters read the road east like a book.

name: Blood Raven's Warning
lore: Remember what became of the best of the Sisters.

name: The Monastery Gate
lore: The Sisters' monastery guarded the only pass between West and East.

name: Storm Callers
lore: To a Sister, a storm is only another kind of arrow.

name: Lightning Reflexes
lore: Faster than the bolt.

name: Storm Rider
lore: Each kill feeds the next bolt.

name: Celestial Aim
lore: An arrow loosed by the inner eye finds its own way.

name: Eye of the Storm
lore: In the middle of the storm, everything is still and clear.

name: Frost of the Archive
lore: The Horadrim fought demons with pure arcane force.

name: Horadric Staff
lore: Staff and amulet joined, the key the Horadrim left to Tal Rasha's tomb.

name: Soulstone Ward
lore: Soulstones held two Prime Evils for centuries.

name: Tyrael's Counsel
lore: Tyrael gathered the best of the mage clans and named them Horadrim.

name: Zhar's Library
lore: 'Here, take this and leave me to my work. Trouble me no more!'

name: Chamber of Bone
lore: Arcane knowledge gained!

name: Zoltun's Insight
lore: Zoltun Kulle knew more than any mage should.

name: Golem Binding
lore: A golem raised by magic fights for its maker and no other.

name: Tal Rasha's Sacrifice
lore: He took the Lord of Destruction into his own flesh so the others could seal the tomb.

name: The Mangler
lore: A great axe that does terrible work and dulls the mind that swings it.

name: Eater of Souls
lore: A great sword that steals life from all it cuts, and slowly from its bearer too.

name: Singing Steel
lore: 'My blade sings for your blood, mortal, and by my dark masters it shall not be denied.'

name: Flowing Strikes
lore: Attack and prayer are one movement.

name: Hundred Palms
lore: Strike faster than the eye can follow.

name: Wind of Ivgorod
lore: The fastest hands in the East, and the thinnest skin.

name: Blackoak Fletching
lore: Arrows of black oak fly straight and true.

name: Eaglehorn Draw
lore: A battle bow drawn to the ear.

name: Fleshstinger
lore: A bow for the archer who would rather kill first and bleed later.

name: Immolator
lore: Fire is the first school a Vizjerei apprentice learns, and the last he forgets.

name: Kindling
lore: A sorcerer who plays with fire learns not to be burned.

name: Ash and Ember
lore: Burn them, and drink what rises from the ash.

name: Executioner
lore: The headsman's axe of Leoric's court fell slowly, and once.

name: Cleaving Blow
lore: A great swing that staggers whatever it does not cut.

name: Reckless Swings
lore: Swing twice where others swing once, and trust that one of them lands.

name: Griswold's Edge
lore: Griswold forged one blade from the Anvil of Fury, and it was quick in the hand.

name: Anvil of Fury
lore: Griswold needed only the Anvil of Fury to forge a blade fit for the labyrinth.

name: The Gladiator's Bane
lore: Studded leather that takes the sting out of every blow.

name: Defender of Tristram
lore: With the army lost in Westmarch, Tristram's few defenders held their own doors.

name: King's Guard
lore: Leoric's household knights were drilled to never give a step.

name: Split Skull Shield
lore: Catch the blow on the shield, then return it with the rim.

name: Unbroken
lore: Some men simply refuse to fall.

name: Blood of Westmarch
lore: Leoric's men left their blood on the fields of Westmarch. Those who came home were harder for it.

name: Golden Elixir
lore: The elixir Lachdanan begged for, to lift a king's curse.

name: Pepin's Poultice
lore: Pepin sent everyone who went below away with a pouch of his salves.

name: Second Wind
lore: Each foe that falls puts breath back in your lungs.

name: Inner Stillness
lore: Breathe, and the well refills.

name: Patriarch's Discipline
lore: The Patriarchs of Ivgorod waste nothing, least of all prayer.

name: Fast of the Patriarchs
lore: A body that has learned to want nothing heals itself.

name: Thunder Palm
lore: A strike that carries the storm in it.

name: Thundercall
lore: A staff that answers the sky.

name: Storm Hymn
lore: Sung to the gods of the storm, who sometimes listen.

name: Frost Kata
lore: Learned in the icy winds that batter the Floating Sky Monastery.

name: Glacier Stance
lore: Plant your feet in the frost you called.

name: Winter Calm
lore: Cold hands, cold mind, no wasted motion.

name: Open Palm
lore: An empty hand hides nothing and needs nothing.

name: Shun the Blade
lore: The monks fight without metal weapons, and are lighter for it.

name: Gonnagal's Dirk
lore: A short blade from the labyrinth, quick and mean.

name: Stalker's Step
lore: Step out of the dark, strike, and step back into it.

name: Cold Steel
lore: Freeze them first, and the knife does the rest.

name: Sightless Aim
lore: The Sisters are taught to shoot with the inner eye.

name: Hunter's Patience
lore: Wait for the shot that matters.

name: Windforce
lore: A great war bow that hurls its target back.

name: Akara's Remedy
lore: The priestess Akara's draughts kept the Sisters alive.

name: Feast of the Fallen
lore: The Fallen breed fast and die faster.

name: Quick Hands
lore: A Sister drinks between heartbeats.

name: The Needler
lore: Many small wounds, quickly given.

name: Gnat Sting
lore: A light bow, and many light arrows.

name: Black Razor
lore: A thin black dagger that cuts far deeper than its size.

name: Shadowhawk
lore: A broadsword that drinks from every foe it fells and keeps its bearer in shadow.

name: Thinking Cap
lore: A plain skull cap that holds more mana than many a staff.

name: Arcane Thirst
lore: Each death leaves a little magic in the air for the taking.

name: Vizjerei Adept
lore: An adept keeps a part of his will apart, always bound to some working.

name: Storm Spire
lore: A war staff from the depths that hums before every storm.

name: Static Field
lore: The air around you crackles and bites, you included.

name: Maelstrom
lore: Faster words, hungrier spells.

name: Frozen Heart
lore: Cold magic answers best to those who feel nothing.

name: Glacial Ward
lore: A shell of frost turns blows aside.

name: Ring of the Mystics
lore: A ring that wards against magic and leaves its wearer open to fire and storm.

name: Vizjerei Binding
lore: The Vizjerei bound demons to their will, and called it scholarship.

name: Horazon's Servants
lore: Horazon kept demons as servants in his sanctuary.

name: Heart of the Golem
lore: A golem walks on a share of its maker's mana.

name: Horazon's Focus
lore: Horazon and his brother Bartuc were the greatest Vizjerei of their age.

name: Quickened Words
lore: The Vizjerei cut every word a demon could twist.

name: Iron Will
lore: Fear has no purchase on a mind made of iron.

name: Hold the Line
lore: Stand and let them break upon you.

name: The Undead Crown
lore: Leoric's crown, pried from his bones. It still drinks from those it strikes.

name: Arkaine's Valor
lore: Arkaine wore Valor when he drove the legions of darkness back to the Burning Hells.

name: Tempered Plate
lore: Steel heated past red takes flame and frost alike.

name: Demonspike Coat
lore: Unbreakable full plate that blunts every blow and turns aside fire.

name: King Leoric's Might
lore: Before the madness, Leoric had always been the holiest of men, and the strongest.

name: Battle Rhythm
lore: A veteran fights to a beat only he can hear.

name: Bloodied Veteran
lore: Scarred by every element and still standing.

name: The Cranium Basher
lore: A maul from the labyrinth, made to crush bone, living or dead.

name: Bone Breaker
lore: Skeletons do not bleed, so the knights learned to shatter them.

name: Veradani Vow
lore: These holy warriors undergo intense mental and physical training.

name: Thousand and One Gods
lore: The monks of Ivgorod find a god in the hearth fire and the river.

name: Gleamsong
lore: A short staff that deepens the mana and weakens the body.

name: Daibo Form
lore: The daibo is the first weapon an initiate of Ivgorod learns, and often the last.

name: Sweeping Staff
lore: A wide arc that knocks them off their feet.

name: The Protector
lore: A staff held across the body turns as many blows as it gives.

name: Perfect Harmony
lore: Order and Chaos, held level, as the Patriarchs hold them.

name: Serene Recovery
lore: Peace heals.

name: Unseen Hand
lore: Spells pass where the monk no longer stands.

name: The Thirteenth Viper
lore: Initiates are thrown into the Pit of Twelve Vipers. No one tells them of the thirteenth.

name: Serpent's Form
lore: The form every initiate masters before any other.

name: Pilgrim's Alms
lore: A monk on the road eats what the road gives.

name: Iron Body
lore: Years of training make the body a weapon and a wall.

name: Floating Sky Training
lore: In the Floating Sky Monastery, body and mind are trained as one.

name: Burning Pitch
lore: Pitch-soaked heads, lit from the campfire.

name: Flaming Volley
lore: Set the whole field ablaze.

name: Flamedart
lore: A bow whose arrows catch light as they leave the string.

name: Kashya's Command
lore: Kashya leads the Sisters with a hard voice and a harder bow.

name: Keen Eyes
lore: You see them; they see you.

name: Sisters' Vigil
lore: One Sister always watches while the others sleep.

name: Storm Arrows
lore: Arrows tipped with captured lightning.

name: Thunderhead
lore: The storm follows the archer.

name: Hoarfrost Shafts
lore: Shafts left out on the monastery walls overnight.

name: Highland Frost
lore: On the Tamoe Highland a Sister learns to strike and keep moving.

name: Halls of the Blind
lore: 'Shadows move where light should be.' In the Halls of the Blind an archer holds her ground and shoots at what moves.

name: Elusive
lore: Walk where the light does not reach.

name: Mana Before Flesh
lore: A sorcerer can let the blow fall on his mana instead of his flesh.

name: Melding
lore: Mana poured into the ward is mana not spent on spells.

name: Quick Recovery
lore: The shield knits itself back the moment you step clear.

name: Mage Clan Wars
lore: When the clans of Kehjistan turned on each other, whole cities burned.

name: Bartuc's Hunger
lore: Bartuc of the Vizjerei bathed in his enemies' blood and took his power from demons.

name: Arcane Sanctuary
lore: Horazon hid in a sanctum of his own making, out of the world's reach.

name: Wellspring
lore: The deeper the well, the stronger the spell.

name: Elemental Mastery
lore: Fire, storm and ice bow to a master, and lash out at him too.

name: Warding Circle
lore: Chalk, salt and old words keep the worst of it out.

name: Wisdom's Wrap
lore: A mage's robe that adds to his mana and softens every blow.
